requirements.note: Inset-grouped list in large-title History, newest first; each row shows name, full date, exercise count and volume (checked a new workout: 135×10 + 50×12 = 1,950 lb).
Detail screen has a Date/Exercises/Sets/Volume summary, then one section per exercise (headed by muscle) listing its sets; the exercise row pushes to the exercise screen.

+ opens a full-height sheet: name field, Add Exercises sheet with a multi-select checkmark list, a bottom search field and a Muscle pull-down menu (search and filter combine). Add Set/Edit Set sheet; native swipe-to-delete on sets; Finish is disabled until there is a name and a set, with a footer explaining why. Finishing adds the workout to the top of History.
Exercises tab lists all 120 grouped by muscle with equipment subtitles. Within a group the order is unsorted (data order), and this screen has no search.
Muscle and equipment, a large Best Set card (heaviest weight, with workout and date), and an 'N Workouts' list that links to each workout. It updated with the newly finished workout.

An empty draft, a draft with exercises and sets, and finished workouts all survived relaunch. Closing the sheet turns the draft into an 'In Progress' row at the top of History and the + button into 'Resume Workout'.

bugs: The Add Set sheet puts focus in Reps even though Weight is the first row and the footer says 'Enter the weight', so the first digits typed go into reps.
Reps and weight fields accept non-numeric text from a hardware keyboard; validation catches it ('Reps must be a whole number'), but the field still shows the junk.
Remove Exercise deletes immediately, with its logged sets, and has no confirmation or undo.
tells: Sets read 'weight × reps' (135 lb × 10), the reverse of the usual 'reps × weight' convention; the history detail and the exercise screen are at least consistent.
Only two tabs; starting a workout is reachable only from the + in the History nav bar.
Library is ordered by id within each muscle group, not alphabetically, so it is hard to scan.
A.scroll: History (61 rows) and the 120-exercise library scroll, fling and rubber-band like a native list, with the scroll-edge blur under the nav bar. There are no blank or popping rows, and the scroll position was kept after pushing a detail and going back.

requirements.note: Large-title History grouped into month sections (October 2026…June 2026), newest first; each row shows name, short date on the right, exercise count and volume. A new workout totalled correctly (10×135 + 9×50 = 1,800 lb).
Detail screen: summary (date, exercises, sets, total volume), then a tappable header per exercise with its sets and a per-exercise volume footer.

Workout tab: name field with suggestion chips, then Start Workout. Live timer and volume. Add Exercises sheet with search field, muscle chips (combine with search) and multi-select circles. Add Set sheet with text fields plus steppers, prefilled from the last time that exercise was done. Edit Set screen has a Delete Set button; swipe-to-delete also works. Finish asks for confirmation in a popover, saves to History and opens the finished workout.
Library tab groups exercises by muscle with counts ('Arms (20)'), alphabetical within each group, and has a search field.
Muscle and equipment, a Best Set card with trophy (weight × reps, workout and date), and 'Workouts (N)' rows listing each workout's sets. It updated with the new workout.
The in-progress workout (name, exercises, sets, start time) and finished workouts survived relaunch; the selected tab is restored too.

bugs: At the largest text size, the 'No Exercises Yet' empty state of a just-started workout is drawn over the form (Started / Volume / exercise count), leaving overlapping, unreadable text.
On an exercise screen reached from a workout, that workout's row is shown stuck in the gray selected highlight (reproducible).
In the exercise screen's workout rows, the set summary wraps inside a value ('6 ×' / '27.5 lb') at default text size. At the largest size the best-set card splits '× 8' / 'reps' awkwardly.
tells: The muscle filter in the picker is a hand-drawn row of capsule chips, not a system Picker or menu.
The empty workout shows two 'Add Exercises' buttons, a list row and a prominent button in the empty state.
The Library tab uses an inline title with a search bar where iOS would show a large title like the other tabs.
The number-pad set fields have no keyboard Done accessory; the keyboard can only be dismissed with Save or Cancel.
B.scroll: History with month sections and the 120-row library scroll, fling and rubber-band smoothly, with native scroll-edge blur and no blank rows or jumps. The scroll position was kept on push and pop.

why: Both meet every requirement with convincingly native lists, sheets, swipe actions and persistence. B goes further: month-sectioned history, a searchable library, set values prefilled from the last session, steppers, a live timer and a finish confirmation. Its largest-text overlap in the empty workout is a real polish flaw, while A is cleaner but plainer, and its Add Set sheet focuses the wrong field. On balance B is the one I would rather use, once that overlap is fixed.
